_source: myWallet -> MyWalletResponse { success, message, error, metadata, data: WalletEntity }. WalletEntity introspected live: balanceVnd:Int!, createdAt!, id!, updatedAt!, user. No relations loaded, so `user` is null on the wire. THERE IS NO EMPTY STATE HERE AND THAT IS THE POINT: the handler CREATES the wallet on first read, so a brand-new account reads a real balanceVnd of 0 rather than an absence. The wallet section therefore has a balance in every situation the product can be in, which is why page-wallet's state inventory names two states and not three. balanceVnd is an Int in the smallest unit of the currency and is formatted by next-intl at the drawing edge; no formatted money string enters this file.
